svg.text: 4 m CLEAR + 1 m SERVICE + 0.3 m SLAB
Artifacts travel straight from B1 garage to B2 intake via a through-car freight lift: west
loading doors at B1, east unloading doors at B2. The west core lobby is retained for staff
and service access. People returning with dirty equipment pass through wash and gowning;
the NW stair reaches the research hall independently. All active rooms have 4 m clear
Concept floor plan · 50% floor tints · Symbolic stair treads / door swings · Not a construction plan
